issue.title: [YCQL] Enhancement needed when supporting INDEX by expressions other than JSONB expression.

labels.name: kind/enhancement
labels.description: This is an enhancement of an existing feature

repository.name: yugabyte-db
repository.description: YugabyteDB - the cloud native distributed SQL database for mission-critical applications.

issue.body:
Jira Link: [DB-4687](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-4687)
Currently for YCQL, we only support indexing columns (e.g. `c`) and jsonb-expressions (e.g. `j->'a'->>'b'`).
_If in the future we want to support more (or arbitrary) expressions_ we will need to reverse the fix for #4881 (i.e. https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/commit/72af174aaebbb85ef1cf40bed6979787b99c5c3b) because that fix handles ONLY JSONB expressions (and simple column references). 
Concretely, to fix #4881, we construct a list of names of columns and JSONB expressions but not other expressions, and therefore only JSONB expression can be supported.

To support ALL expressions, we must first do the following.
- The above fix for #4881 must be reversed.
- The column mangling method should be fixed. Currently, column names are mangled by prefixing with "$C".  However, a name postfix is missing in the mangling method. Without postfix, the mangled names are ambiguous as the same name can be matched with different expressions.  For example,

"$C_v+77" can be interpreted in many different ways.
(1) Use as a single column
```
Column of name "v+77"
```

(2) Use as an expression.
```
Expression (v + 77)
```

body:
Fixed by https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/commit/72af174aaebbb85ef1cf40bed6979787b99c5c3b
A language extension to support INDEX by different expressions would require changes reported in #4932
@nocaway -- can we close this issue now?

This was fixed by https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/commit/cce77ad087402d9fb8f43b33b89698b92e6dfc60 (2.2.0 release branch) and https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/commit/2a4fd13b47776a5e6eb73d2e3ed0b67316948d0a (master branch)
( ALL previous commits on code changes and tests for this issue had been reverted ).
